name: Bea Hackula
text:
Joyce is an exceptionally talented, diligent, and creative professional who made a profound impact during her five years with our team. She possesses a rare combination of strategic foresight and meticulous attention to detail, which she demonstrated consistently across high-stakes projects.
Among her many contributions, Joyce masterfully spearheaded our complex awards nomination process and expertly managed our social media artists. Her ability to champion creative talent, elevate brand presence, and deliver flawless execution under tight deadlines is truly remarkable.
Joyce brings a positive attitude, unwavering reliability, and a high standard of excellence to everything she touches. She is a natural leader and a phenomenal team player who leaves a lasting legacy of professionalism.
Any organization would be incredibly fortunate to have Joyce. She has my highest recommendation as she transitions into the next chapter of her career.

name: Angeline Mhlanga
role: Country Head ? CBW Zimbabwe; Ambassador for Diversity & Culture, CBW Africa
text:
I have had the pleasure of working alongside Joyce and witnessing firsthand the passion, excellence, and professionalism she brings to the media space. She is truly a global leader who understands the power of storytelling, connection, and creating platforms that amplify voices across our continent.

Joyce has an incredible ability to bring people together and organise impactful events across Africa, always with grace, precision, and heart. Her dedication to building meaningful networks and creating opportunities for collaboration is something I deeply admire.

The launch of NJC Global is a beautiful reflection of her vision, creativity, and commitment to making a difference through media. I have no doubt that this platform will continue to inspire, connect, and grow in powerful ways. I am incredibly proud of her and excited to see all that lies ahead.
